Definition: Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shebaniah is the name of several men who served at the ark and at the covenant. One blew the trumpet before the ark of God when David brought it up, another sealed the covenant with Nehemiah, and another stands in the lists of the priests. The name means increased by Jehovah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe increased by Jehovah fits these men: they are remembered for sounding the trumpet, signing the covenant, and keeping the priest's course, and I hold that God still increases those who serve His house.
